content: Gwenad-bur-yeer-ito be imakmar
Degisoggu, anmar Jesúsʼgi-bensuli-gannarba-gudimalad, gwenadgan-Jesúsʼgi-bensulid-nollo-gudimalad-bendakewilubmar. Mer dukin anmar na yeer-itogedginbi binsamar.
Anmar na war-wargwen gwenad-baid ibmar-nuedgi-yeer-itogega imakmar, adi, anmar a-gwenad e-ulubgi ogannogegar.
Ar Cristoʼbela ibmar na dukin-yeer-itogega imaksasulid. Ar igi-Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar nai, deyob gusad:
Salmo 69:9

Ar ade, iduar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi ibmar-narmaklesmaladi, anmar-odurdakegala narmaklesad. Adi, anmar Bab-Dummad-Garda-wisidba, gwae-gwae-itosulidgi, degi, gwage-ogannolegedgi, degine, bensulidgi, ibmar-edarbedii gumalagar.
Bab-Dummad-gwae-gwae-itosuli-anmar-imakedi, degine, anmar-gwage-ogannogedi, bitigi Cristo-Jesús-nanasadyobi, gwenatigwar-gudigumalaga, degi, na emarbi-itoge bemar-imakena gadin.
Adi, bemar bela bulakwaa, unnila gaya-gwennagwayobi, Bab-Dummad anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-e-Bab-e-nug, odummomalagar.
Bab-Gayaburba-Nued Judíoʼsurmaladga uklesmogad
Degisoggu, ar igi Cristo anmar-abingasmoga, deyob na be muchub-muchub abingamarmo. Adi, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannolegegar.

An bemarga sogsun: Cristo-Jesús Judíoʼmar-maiga-guega nonikid, adi, Bab-Dummad-napira-ibmar-imaked oyogegar. Degi, Bab-Dummad-anmar-dadganga-ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, imakbaligar. Deyob guegala, Cristo nonikid.
Degine, Cristo nonibalid, adi, Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Dummad-wilesakwaa-e-daked-ular, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannomalagar. Ar igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar nai:
2 Samuel 22:50; Salmo 18:49
Amba Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaibalid:
Deuteronomio 32:43
Degine, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi amba sognaibalid:
Salmo 117:1
Amba Isaías weyob narmaksamogad:
Isaías 11:10

Bab-Dummad-ibmar-bensuli-edarbedi-anmar-imakedi, bemar-egi-bensuli-gunonikidba bela weligwar-itogega, degine, ulubgi bogidik-itogega bemar-imakena gadin. Adi, bemar Bab-Burba-Isligwaled-gangued-nikadba, bur bule Bab-Dummadgi-bensuli-edarbedii be gumalagar.
Pablo, Judíoʼsurmalad-abargi Jesús-Igargi arbasad
Gwenadgan, bemargi an bensurdo. Ar an nue-wisid, bemar ibmar-nued-imakbiedbina gudimalad, degine, be Bab-Jesús-igar nue-wismarbalid. Degisoggu, sunna na be muchub-muchub ogannomardo.
Degi-inigwele, gwenadgan, Bab-Dummad nabir angi binsaewilubsulinad. Degite, nabir angi binsasad. A-ular, anga-igar-uksadi, an bemarga gannabasaar narmaksado, adi, bemar insamalagar.

Ar Judíoʼsurmaladga-sunmakegala Jesucristoʼga-arbaega an nugsalesad. Degisoggu, Bab-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an sunmakdisunnad, adi, Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-nued-uklegedyob gumalaga, Bab-Burba-Isligwaledba swilidik gumalagar.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummadga an Cristo-Jesúsʼba-ibmar-imakedgi an bela-bela yeer itoged.

Ar degisulile, an sunmakbi itossuliled. Emigindi, an sunmakdo, igi angi Cristo Bab-Dummadba-ibsaega Judíoʼsurmalad-imaksa. An imaksadi, an-sunmaksadginbi an imaksasulid, an-ibmar-imaksadgi an imaksabalid.

Weyob-an-imaksadi, Bab-Burba-Isligwaled-ganguedba ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid an imaksad, degine, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad an imaksabalid. Degisoggu, Jerusalén-neggwebur, degine, a-neggweburmar-dikarbarmalad-akale, Ilírico-yarsega, bela Cristo-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an sunmaksad.
Weyobi, Bab-Gayaburba-Nuedgi-sunmakegala, bia amba yoo Cristoʼgi sunmaklege, agi an alamaknai gudigusad, adi, melle dule-baid-Bab-Gayaburba-Nuedgi-sunmaksad-sorba an sunmakegar.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob:
Isaías 52:15
Agala, we-arbaed-ular, geg an bemarse nue-nae an gusad.
Pablo Roma-neggweburse gwenadganse-ataknaedgi binsaed
Ar emigindi, wegi an-arbaed anga bergunonisoggu, degine, birga-dikasurgus an bemarse ataknabi gudisoggu,
España-yarse an nadele, bemarse an atakee naoed. Bemar-walik an weligwar-gudiguoed-sorba, Españaʼse be an-barmidmalaga, be an-bendakmalo an insado.
Ar emigindi, an Jerusalén-neggweburse naesokalid, Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimalad-agi-bukmaladga mani berbenaegar.
Ar ade, gwenadgan-Macedonia-yarginmalad, degine, gwenadgan-Acaya-yarginmalad, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-Jerusalénʼgi-bukmalad-abargi-wilegana-gudimaladga mani-weed nue-yeer itosmalad.

Ar we-gwenadgan nue-yeer-itogedgi mani-wesmalad, ar amba emar-bendakergebmalad. Ar Judíoʼsurmalad Judíoʼmarba nabir ibmar-burbaled nikusmarmosoggu, Judíoʼsurmalad Judíoʼmarga ibmar-sanaled ukmarmogargebed.
Degisoggu, we-ibmar-imaked an obelosale, we-mani an uksad-sorbali, España-yarse an nadoed, agi an bemarse atakee nadapoed.
An nue-wisdo, an bemarse modapile, Cristo-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an bemarga sunmakdele, Bab-Dummad bela-bela anmargi nued binsaoed.
Degi-inigwele, gwenadgan, bemarse nue-ise-wilesakwaa anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nuggi an egis, degine, Bab-Burba-Isligwaled-anmar-sabedba an egisba, Bab-Dummadse-anga-goledgi be an-bendakmar.
Adi, Judea-yargi Bab-Jesúsʼba-ibsabisurmaladi melle angi yolemalagar, degine, an mani-semaid, Jerusalénʼgi Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimalad-bukmalad nuedgi abingamalagar.
Adi, an bemarse warmakdapir, weligwaledgi Bab-Dummad-sogedba an modapi-guegar, adi, bemar-abargi an obunnogegar.
Degine, Bab-Dummad-Ulubgi-bogidik-itoge-anmar-imaked, bela bemarba gudii guo. Deyob gusun.
